title: CarrierBooking
description: A booking request, as Norvia's P4 booking Logic App sends it to a Carrier's booking endpoint (Carrier booking format, version 1). It differs from the Canonical Model on purpose: its own field names, flat address fields, local date/times without an offset in the time zone of the address they belong to, and ISO 3166 alpha-3 country codes. It never names the Shipper and carries nothing from the Shipper's Rate Card. The Carrier booking number is its key: a request sent again is ignored.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier booking, the key of the request.

consigneeName.description: Who receives the goods, the only thing the Carrier is told about the Consignee.

localTime.description: Local date/time at the address the window belongs to, without an offset.

packageType.description: One of pallet, parcel, crate or loose.

weightKg.description: Weight of the whole line in kilograms.
